['RTL Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: RTL Deutschland GmbH, formerly known as Mediengruppe RTL Deutschland, is a German media company based in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia. It operates as a holding company for the German television, broadcasting, and content production businesses of the RTL Group. The company is the largest private television network in Germany and offers national streaming platforms, content productions, and a range of digital services.
